description: This file implements the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application. It serves as the main home screen, displaying a top navigation bar and multiple content sections (rails) with horizontally scrollable content cards. It includes setup for brand styling, RecyclerView adapters for navigation and content, mock data models, and accessibility features.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment representing the home screen with navigation and content sections.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Data model for individual media content entries.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Represents a row of content items within the home screen.

classes.name: MockContentData
classes.description: Utility object generating mock content data.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and returns the root view.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the home screen components after view creation.

methods.name: setupBrand
methods.description: Configures the brand text with styled spans.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Sets up the top navigation RecyclerView with categories and focus behavior.

methods.name: setupSectionsList
methods.description: Initializes the list of content sections with mock data.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Old method for configuring content rails; replaced by sections list setup.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up binding reference to prevent memory leaks.
